archive.question: Which priority does the speaker give to decisions?
options: keeping a decision open to revision

groups.question: Which reports does the speaker put at the front of an archive?
plus: I put the newest reports at the front of my archive.
For my archive I file the latest reports first.
minus: I put the oldest reports at the front of my archive.
For my archive I file the earliest reports first.

groups.question: Which path does the speaker prefer on a walk?
plus: I choose the riverside trail for my walks.
When walking, I favor following the riverbank.
minus: I choose the ridge trail for my walks.
When walking, I favor following the crest of the hill.

groups.question: How does the speaker prefer to take meeting notes?
plus: I record a meeting in the speakers' exact words.
My meeting notes preserve what people say word for word.
minus: I record a meeting by summarizing its main points.
My meeting notes capture the gist of what people say.

groups.question: Which temperature scale does the speaker use in a weather log?
plus: I record the weather in degrees Celsius.
My weather diary uses the Celsius scale.
minus: I record the weather in degrees Fahrenheit.
My weather diary uses the Fahrenheit scale.

groups.question: What determines where the speaker shelves a book?
plus: I group the books on my shelves by author.
On my bookshelf, works by the same writer sit together.
minus: I group the books on my shelves by subject.
On my bookshelf, works on the same topic sit together.

groups.question: What does the speaker use when giving directions?
plus: I give directions by naming the streets to take.
I guide people by telling them the road names.
minus: I give directions by pointing out landmarks along the way.
I guide people by describing recognizable sights on the route.
